content: I like this idea, but the dot should be placed between the the last integer places and the first decimal place,  rather on the last integer place

✅ Approved the contribution.
Comment: Good puzzle and test cases. Definitely suits classic better than CoC.
Converted clash (https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/1513204ef2cd43554d65c96f98c8cdc37dea89), based on the feedback from @Compootah and @jonas_melo.
You mean on the abacus itself? That's just how they are made though

Maybe, but that's not like this in all abacus (for example, mine that my grandmother bought for me has no dot, you place it mentaly where it's the most practical)
end anyway, not every one has an abacus at home so it would be easier to understand if you place the dot just one more character in the right

The number representation for the soroban is this way; see https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Soroban#Representation_of_numbers. I've explained how the columns are meant to be read with respect to the dot in the description, so there should be no need for players to have experiences with using an abacus.

Thanks for your feedback though @deepfish. While I am not inclined to change the representation, perhaps other players may have the same concern as you; let's wait to hear from other commenters.
